players.product: nuclear power purchase agreements and Calpine powered-land agreements for AI data centers

connects_to.relationship: Calpine powered-land agreements (power, grid connectivity and site infrastructure) for CyrusOne data centers at the Freestone and Thad Hill Energy Centers in Texas

contracts.signal: CEO Joseph Dominguez: last week Constellation received PUCT approval of the net metering agreement associated with its powered land deal with CyrusOne at the Freestone Energy Center; construction is underway on the substation that will enable power delivery to the data center, expected to be energized in the fourth quarter of this year.
